about: How big each Versus site really is, measured by tools/tower-size.mjs: the interactive elements on its home page (controls: links, inputs, buttons, selects), transfer bytes of its home page plus its own scripts and styles, script and element counts, routes (sitemap urls, else internal links). The queue ranks the fewest controls first, the fewer bytes on a tie. weight = bytes + 2000 per script + 10 per element + 500 per route (lib/tower-weight.js). Keyed by host.
